commands.cmd: p=$(command -v mcporter) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && mcporter --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" mcporter

bt=$(mktemp); at=$(mktemp); pgrep -f 'mcporter|headroom' | sort > "$bt"; mcporter list 2>&1; echo "---"; mcporter call headroom.headroom_stats --output json --no-oauth --timeout 20000; rc=$?; sleep 0.5; pgrep -f 'mcporter|headroom' | sort > "$at"; new=$(comm -13 "$bt" "$at"); echo "---"; echo "call exit: $rc | new PIDs left running by this call: [$new]"; rm -f "$bt" "$at"; test "$rc" -eq 0 && test -z "$new"
